description: Epistemic protocols for Claude Code — structure human-AI interaction quality at every decision point - https://epistemic-protocols.com

plugins.name: katalepsis
plugins.description: Close on an understanding that serves your purpose, on a map built with you and checked against its material — /grasp (κατάληψις: a grasping firmly)

plugins.name: aitesis
plugins.description: Recognize what the work rests on — what was settled and from where, what rests on weak or unreached ground, what only you decide — /inquire (αἴτησις: a requesting)

plugins.name: analogia
plugins.description: See what a framework, analogy, or earlier design carried to a case supports — each conclusion's grounds, checks, defeaters, and verdict — /ground (ἀναλογία: a proportion)

plugins.name: periagoge
plugins.description: Name what your cases share, say which cases it takes in and leaves out, and recognize it as serving your goal — /induce (περιαγωγή: turning-around)

plugins.name: euporia
plugins.description: Reach an intent you can call yours, aligned enough — each recorded value on your own words, what you left open carried — /elicit (εὐπορία: way through)

plugins.name: merismos
plugins.description: Take as yours a plan cutting one autonomous goal into units, each with its checks, accepted gaps, and held judgments — /apportion (μερισμός: an apportionment)

plugins.name: epharmoge
plugins.description: See on one sheet where a result does not fit your situation, each misfit settled or withdrawn, the fixes carried out and reread — /contextualize (ἐφαρμογή: an application)

plugins.name: horismos
plugins.description: See the decisions a task rests on — what each costs if wrong, what settled it, what stays open and who settles it — /bound (ὁρισμός: a bounding)

plugins.name: epistemic-cooperative
plugins.description: Utility skills layered on top of the core protocols; each utility skill's own SKILL.md carries its contract.

plugins.name: anamnesis
plugins.description: Recognize the past you reached for — a session, line of work, topic, or concept — in a story on records you can reopen: it took place, not that it still holds — /recollect (ἀνάμνησις: a recollecting)

plugins.name: hyphegesis
plugins.description: Take as yours how several lines of work run — order, combination, stopping points, where results go, what you entrusted and kept — /conduct (ὑφήγησις: a leading-the-way)

plugins.name: proplasma
plugins.description: See what taking each candidate direction means for your purpose and on what ground, then settle the one you take — /preview (πρόπλασμα: a preliminary clay model)

plugins.name: hypotyposis
plugins.description: React to concrete versions until you can point at one you met and say: this is the form, for this purpose — /sketch (ὑποτύπωσις: an outline, a first sketch)

plugins.name: heuresis
plugins.description: Look over one map of your idea field — frames and branches, each idea's origin, what stays unexplored or set aside — and take it forward, nothing chosen — /ideate (εὕρεσις: finding/invention)

plugins.name: route
plugins.description: Meet the deficit your context shows as the core protocol that resolves it, and see why, without recalling which exist — /route (per-prompt hook directive)

plugins.name: monitor-etf-holdings-drawdown-risk
plugins.description: 偵測「商品價格上漲、但對應實物 ETF/信託持倉卻下滑」的背離現象，並用多指標交叉驗證，評估是否存在實物供給緊張/交割壓力風險

plugins.name: lithium-supply-demand-gap-radar
plugins.description: 將鋰產業鏈（礦端 → 精煉化學品 → 電池與終端需求），整合為一套可運算的替代指標；再把這些指標映射到鋰主題 ETF（如 LIT）的成分暴露與長期價格走勢，形成可供決策的依據。

plugins.name: list-china-today-macro-news
plugins.description: 彙整今日中國宏觀經濟新聞消息，從華爾街日報、36氪等來源抓取並篩選宏觀相關新聞，輸出雜誌風格的新聞摘要。適用於交易/研究開盤前快速掌握中國宏觀動態。

plugins.name: google-trends-ath-detector
plugins.description: 模擬真人操作瀏覽器抓取 Google Trends 數據，自動判定搜尋趨勢是否創下歷史新高（ATH）或出現異常飆升，並提供訊號分類。

plugins.name: forecast-sector-relative-return-from-yield-spread
plugins.description: 用美債殖利率曲線利差（如 2Y-10Y）建立領先關係，推估未來一段時間內成長股（Nasdaq 100）相對防禦股（Healthcare/XLV）的相對績效方向與幅度。

plugins.name: detect-us-equity-valuation-percentile-extreme
plugins.description: 把多個股票估值指標統一轉成在過去百年歷史中的分位數，再合成一個總分，判斷目前是否處於歷史極端高估區間，並用歷史類比（如 1929、1965、1999）給出風險解讀

plugins.name: detect-shanghai-silver-stock-drain
plugins.description: 以公開交易所庫存資料為核心，量化上海白銀庫存耗盡的方向、速度與加速度，並將其轉成可交易的供給緊縮訊號

plugins.name: evaluate-exponential-trend-deviation-regimes
plugins.description: 計算資產價格相對長期指數成長趨勢線的偏離度，衡量當前是否處於歷史極端區間，並可選擇性地進行宏觀因子分析以判斷行情體質。

plugins.name: detect-freight-led-inflation-turn
plugins.description: 透過美國卡斯貨運指數 (CASS Freight Index) 的週期轉折，偵測美國通膨壓力是否進入放緩或反轉階段。用於判斷「通膨是否正在降溫」，並驗證市場對降息、通膨回落的宏觀敘事是否有實體經濟數據支撐。

plugins.name: detect-palladium-lead-silver-turns
plugins.description: 以鈀金的先行轉向作為確認條件，檢驗白銀短期漲跌是否獲得工業景氣與風險情緒的同步支持，並標記缺乏鈀金參與度的失敗走勢。

plugins.name: detect-fed-unamortized-discount-pattern
plugins.description: 檢查聯準會持有證券的未攤銷折價（Unamortized Discounts）是否出現與特定歷史危機期間相似的走勢模板，並用多指標交叉驗證是否真的屬於「金融壓力升高」而非單純會計/利率效果

plugins.name: detect-atr-squeeze-regime
plugins.description: 以 14 日指數平滑 ATR 偵測市場是否從秩序型趨勢轉為波動主導的擠壓（squeeze）行情，並輸出對技術位、停損、交易持有期的可行性評估。

plugins.name: demographic-fiscal-trap-analyzer
plugins.description: 分析人口老化、債務動態、官僚膨脹與通膨稀釋交互作用下的「財政陷阱」風險，量化各國/地區的財政脆弱度並識別潛在的貨幣稀釋路徑

plugins.name: cost-density-net-rr-calculator
plugins.description: 計算非線性交易成本對風險報酬比的影響。將固定手續費與買賣價差整合為統一的成本密度（Cost Density）指標，揭示停損幅度與策略效率之間呈現雙曲線式的關係。

plugins.name: backsolve-miner-vs-metal-ratio-with-fundamentals
plugins.description: 從網路自動抓取礦業公司財務報表與營運揭露（產量、成本、資本支出），回算「礦業股/金屬本體比率」的基本面解釋與區間門檻（如 1.2/1.7），並輸出可重現的估值拆解（成本因子 / 槓桿因子 / 倍數因子 / 稀釋因子）。

plugins.name: analyze-us-bank-credit-deposit-decoupling
plugins.description: 分析銀行貸款與存款之間的「信貸創造脫鉤」現象，用以辨識聯準會緊縮政策在銀行體系內部的真實傳導效果。

plugins.name: analyze-rolex-market-index-liquidity-proxy
plugins.description: 用勞力士市場指數（WatchCharts Rolex Market Index）作為高 β 的風險偏好／流動性代理，建立可重現的公開數據流程，判讀「流動性改善但未到投機狂熱」的狀態

plugins.name: analyze-silver-miner-metal-ratio
plugins.description: 以「銀礦股價格 / 白銀價格」的相對比率衡量礦業股板塊相對於金屬本體的估值區間（偏貴/偏便宜），並用歷史分位數與類比區間推導「底部/頂部」訊號與情境推演。

plugins.name: analyze-retail-inverse-etf-allocation
plugins.description: 以槓桿反向 ETF（做空）相對槓桿正向 ETF（做多）的交易占比，作為散戶風險偏好（自滿 vs 避險）代理指標，評估 SPX 後續下行風險。

plugins.name: analyze-platinum-to-brazil-equities-transmission
plugins.description: 使用公開市場資料量化驗證鉑/白金對巴西股市（EWZ）的長週期傳導/連動關係，輸出雙軸圖、領先落後分析、關聯強度分數與監控訊號。

plugins.name: analyze-move-risk-gauges-leadlag
plugins.description: 用公開市場數據檢查「利率波動率（MOVE）是否對利率事件（如 JGB 殖利率變動）不恐慌，並且是否領先帶動 VIX / 信用利差走低」

plugins.name: analyze-jgb-insurer-superlong-flow
plugins.description: 從日本保險公司對長端/超長端 JGB 的淨買入(淨賣出) 時間序列，自動產出「本月是否創紀錄賣超、連續賣超月數、期間累積賣超」等結論。

plugins.description: 理论溯源与案例重释。审查 PPT、课程、文案或方法论中的经验判断，先判断命题是否成立，再匹配并核实可信理论，用该理论重释案例并标明边界。适用于给自创理论找依据、给 PPT 补理论来源、判断一句话能否上升为理论、检查是否硬套名人；聚焦单次理论锚定，不默认展开历史同构研究。

plugins.name: dbs-action
plugins.description: 用阿德勒心理学框架诊断执行阻滞。用户知道该做什么却迟迟不做、反复拖延或行动中断时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-content
plugins.description: 围绕已经确定的选题诊断内容怎么组织、论证和表达，形成创作方案。用户要把选题做成内容时使用；不负责已有稿件的逐句删改和标题开头成稿。

plugins.name: dbs-content-value
plugins.description: 评估发布前或低流量内容会吸引谁、开头能否留人，以及流量和商业价值。适用于整体内容表现判断；不负责传播机制解读或整篇逐句改稿。

plugins.name: dbs-content-risk-check
plugins.description: 面向创作者的内容发布风险检查。逐句检查自媒体、社交媒体和内容平台的标题、正文、图片文字、字幕、口播、评论、账号资料及视频画面，分别判断平台机器可能识别什么、内容本身存在什么实质问题，并给出具体位置和最小修改动作；需要明确视频语境边界时，额外生成真实准确的三行贴片小字。用户询问「检查敏感词」「发布前排雷」「这篇内容哪里可能违规」「这条小红书能不能发」「视频上放什么声明」时使用。保留强观点、情绪张力、个人风格和传播钩子。

plugins.name: dbs-content-system
plugins.description: 把本地文稿、推文、选题、案例和课程稿整理成可持续生长、可重组复用的内容工程。用户要求结构化内容资产、整理旧素材或建立主题地图时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-video-extract
plugins.description: 从抖音、小红书、微信视频号等平台链接或分享文案查询作品／账号数据并提取语音文字稿，按作者和标题归档为 Markdown。用户要求解析平台视频或取得数据、文字稿时使用；需配置 TikHub 与轻抖凭证，不负责本地成片章节导航或导航视频渲染。

plugins.name: dbs-video-navigation
plugins.description: 根据本地视频或带时间戳字幕划分章节、话题或步骤，生成可导入剪辑软件的导航条 MP4、动态分段进度和时间表。用户要求视频章节导航、顶部进度条或当前位置提示时使用；不负责平台链接数据提取或标题封面开头文案。

plugins.name: dbs-knowledge
plugins.description: 把本地文件夹建成 Agent 可稳定查找、收录和维护的知识库，并支持导航、版本判断、健康检查及 SOT 分层治理。用户要求搭建、查询、更新、整理或瘦身知识库时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-title-cover-intro
plugins.description: 为短视频、图文和文章生成或修改文字标题、封面文字和视频开头。先按稿件与拍摄状态把素材扩展成面向不同人群的选题供用户挑选，并询问能让观众相信作者的经历或数字，再一屏交付小红书、B 站、抖音、视频号的标题、封面与开头。用户要写标题、封面文字、开头、冷开场或多平台适配时使用；不生成封面图片或发布风险声明。

plugins.name: dbs-deconstruct
plugins.description: 用维特根斯坦与奥派经济学方法拆解模糊的商业概念。用户要求解释一个词、澄清概念边界或识别概念混用时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-chatroom-austrian
plugins.description: 由哈耶克、米塞斯与 Claude 从奥派经济学视角展开多角色讨论。用户要求进入奥派聊天室或用奥派分析问题时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-chatroom
plugins.description: 根据话题推荐或接受用户指定的专家，模拟多角色对话并总结分歧。用户要求专家讨论、定向聊天室或继续当前讨论时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-ai-check
plugins.description: 扫描文案中的 AI 写作特征并输出检测报告，默认只诊断不改写；用户看完报告说「我想改」后，逐条追问写法背后的意图并给出修改方向。用户要求检查 AI 味、AI 痕迹或机器化表达时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-plain-writing
plugins.description: 按事实与功能顺序直接撰写、改写或检查产品、工具、功能、项目和更新说明，内置 ASD-STE100 清晰表达原则，核对主体、动作、指代、术语、条件与承诺强度，保留原意和用户锁定的文字，不加营销钩子、痛点渲染和抽象包装。用户要求平铺直叙地写、不要营销腔、把能力逐条写清、检查措辞歧义或只改指定一处时使用；中文为原则适配，不等于官方符合性认证。

plugins.name: dbs-wechat-html
plugins.description: 把 Markdown 转成可粘贴到微信公众号后台的 HTML，并提供 15 种内置风格。用户要求生成公众号 HTML、制作微信版本或排版公众号文章时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-install-skill
plugins.description: 将单个 Skill 或 Skill 集合安装到通用 Agents、Claude Code、Codex、WorkBuddy、Grok、Hermes Agent、Kiro、Qwen Code、Cline 等 Agent。用户要求跨 Agent 安装、同步、查看、去重或卸载 Skill 时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-skill-maker
plugins.description: 制作新 Skill，或改进已有 Skill。先按改动规模给出方案并等待确认，再生成或修改文件，并用真实任务对比改动前后的表现。用户要求做 Skill、把反复出现的问题沉淀成 Skill、修改或修复 Skill、根据失败案例改进 Skill、检查或测试 Skill 时使用；只有用户明确要求分享或发布时，才准备 GitHub 仓库并验证 `npx skills add`。

plugins.name: dbs-human-dispatch
plugins.description: 当用户希望将任务交给员工或协作者并跟进结果时，结合本地人员资料选择负责人，写清要求、协商工期、提供帮助并验收汇报；有飞书 CLI 时派单、读取回填和回复，缺少工具或权限时交付可转发文字。支持事件队列与可配置 Agent 接入，不承担招聘、绩效排名或惩罚。

plugins.name: dbs-save
plugins.description: 把当前诊断的关键状态保存到本地，并查看或设置存档位置。用户要求保存结论、跨会话续接或修改存档位置时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-restore
plugins.description: 恢复由 dbs-save 保存的最近诊断状态。用户要求接着上次、查看此前结论或继续未完成诊断时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-report
plugins.description: 把多次 dbs-save 存档合并成可交付的 Markdown 报告。用户要求汇总诊断、整理报告或生成可分享材料时使用。

plugins.name: dbs-goal
plugins.description: 提取已有约束，只追问影响执行或验收的信息，把模糊愿望整理成可行动、可检查的交付目标。用户要明确做成什么、边界和验收标准时使用；不替代概念拆解或研究问题改写。

plugins.name: dbs-good-question
plugins.description: 把模糊提问改写成 Agent 可推理、可批评、可验证的问题说明书，并判断自动化可解程度。用户要改进问题表述、研究问题或评估 Agent 可解性时使用；任务交付目标已明确时不重复澄清目标。

plugins.name: dbs-jtbd
plugins.description: 用 Jobs to Be Done 识别具体情境中用户想推进的进展、切换方案的力量和选择标准，解释产品、服务或内容为何被选择。用户要求分析顾客任务、购买动机、替代方案或明确用 JTBD 重写提示词时使用；普通任务验收标准澄清无需套用该框架。

plugins.description: 실무 범용 코어 AI 코워커 — 브랜드·제안서·보고·협상·프로세스 등 비즈니스 실무와 목표·습관·회고·여행·웰니스·행사기획을 돕습니다. 전문 영역은 해당 분야 플러그인으로 연결합니다. 이런 분께 추천: 1인 사업자·스타트업 운영자.

plugins.name: moai-writer
plugins.description: 출판·텍스트 전담 AI 코워커 — 도서 기획·집필·퇴고·제안서·출판사 조사와 한국어 윤문을 돕습니다. 공개 맞춤법 검사기는 이용 조건과 원고 공개 범위를 확인한 뒤 사용자 주도로 사용합니다. 스토리/IP 창작은 별도 moai-story 플러그인이 담당합니다. 이런 분께 추천: 작가·1인 출판인·실용서 저자.

plugins.name: moai-story
plugins.description: 스토리/IP 창작 전담 AI 코워커 — 웹툰 제작 체인(기획→캐릭터→회차→식자→작화→QC)·웹소설 연재(기획→집필)·영상 시나리오·콘티·표지·IP 사업화 스킬. 플랫폼 제출 규격은 현재 공고를 확인합니다. 이미지는 앱 도구로 생성하고, Higgsfield 요청은 공식 연결을 확인합니다. 자연어 요청 시 매칭 스킬이 자동 호출됩니다. 이런 분께 추천: 웹툰/웹소설 창작자·시나리오 작가·IP 콘텐츠 기획자.

plugins.name: moai-marketer
plugins.description: 마케팅 전담 AI 코워커 — 캠페인 기획·퍼포먼스 분석·키워드 리서치·그로스 실험·리텐션, 블로그·뉴스레터·SNS 콘텐츠 스킬. Meta Ads·게시 채널 MCP 연동. 일반 이미지는 ChatGPT 기본 도구를 확인하고, 전문 미디어 제작은 연결된 도구와 moai-media 스킬을 활용합니다. 이런 분께 추천: 마케터·콘텐츠 크리에이터·1인 브랜드.

plugins.name: moai-media
plugins.description: 미디어 생성 전담 AI 코워커 — 이미지·영상·오디오 생성 스킬. ChatGPT 기본 이미지 도구, 별도 API 키로 정확한 GPT Image 2.5 생성, Higgsfield 공식 연결의 이미지·영상·제품 촬영, ElevenLabs 오디오, Gemini·Midjourney·NotebookLM 프롬프트 작업을 지원합니다. Higgsfield 3D·설명 영상 완성은 현재 연결에 제출·조립 도구가 있을 때만 진행합니다.

plugins.name: moai-seller
plugins.description: 이커머스 셀러 전담 AI 코워커 — 스마트스토어·아임웹·카페24 MCP 연동과 상세페이지·마켓플레이스·광고·CRM 등 커머스 실무 스킬. VOC·채널 메시지는 moai-cs(CS매니저)로 이관. 자연어 요청 시 매칭 스킬이 자동 호출됩니다. 이런 분께 추천: 온라인 셀러·이커머스 운영자.

plugins.name: moai-officer
plugins.description: 사무 문서 전담 AI 코워커 — 한국형 오피스 문서(HWPX·DOCX·XLSX·PPTX·PDF)·HTML 리포트/슬라이드 생성, 공문서 파싱, 노션 템플릿·생산성 루틴 스킬. kordoc MCP 연동. 공공데이터 조회·데이터 분석은 moai-analyst로, 라이프스타일은 moai-coworker로 분리. 자연어 요청 시 매칭 스킬이 자동 호출됩니다. 이런 분께 추천: 사무직·기획자·자영업 운영자.

plugins.name: moai-analyst
plugins.description: 데이터·공공데이터 분석 전담 AI 코워커 — 데이터 프로파일링·시각화, 공공데이터 조회(부동산·경매·주식·KOSIS·건축물대장·DART 전자공시) 스킬 7종. KOSIS 통계·건축HUB·DART MCP 연동. 자연어 요청 시 매칭 스킬이 자동 호출됩니다. 이런 분께 추천: 데이터 애널리스트·사무직·기획자·자영업 운영자.

plugins.name: moai-lawyer
plugins.description: 법무 전담 AI 코워커 — 계약 검토·NDA 트리아지·컴플라이언스 점검·법령/판례 리서치·국내외 특허/상표 선행조사·식약처 안전 기준 스킬. 국가법령정보 MCP(korean-law)로 인용을 검증하고, 특허/상표 공식 데이터 MCP(moai-mcp-ip)로 한국·미국·일본·유럽 DB를 조회합니다. 이런 분께 추천: 1인 사업자·스타트업 운영자. ※ 법률 자문 대체가 아닌 참고 자료입니다.

plugins.description: 재무·세무 전담 AI 코워커 — 재무제표 분석·결산 관리·차이 분석·IR, 개인 세금 절약·가계 예산·투자 입문·보험 적합성 스킬. OpenDART 전자공시 MCP 연결을 지원합니다. 사업자·재무 담당자·개인 재테크 입문자를 위한 참고 자료이며 세무사·회계사 자문을 대체하지 않습니다.

plugins.description: 인사·채용 전담 AI 코워커(고용주 편) — 채용 공고 분석·이력서 스크리닝·오퍼레터/근로계약서·성과평가·People Ops를 돕습니다. 구직자 편은 moai-career(커리어코치)로 분리되었습니다. 이런 분께 추천: 채용 담당자·인사 실무자.

plugins.name: backtrader-event-driven
plugins.description: 运行经典双均线交叉策略回测，事件驱动模拟信号生成与持仓，输出 PyFolio 绩效报告。触发场景：(1) 用户要做均线策略回测；(2) 用户要打印 OHLC 数据排查数据源；(3) 用户要获取夏普比率、最大回撤等组合分析指标。

description: 🎩 a small bag of clever LLM hacks

plugins.name: deadpan
plugins.description: the answer. nothing else. — strip LLM replies of personality, filler, hedging, emoji, and sycophancy.

plugins.name: snitch
plugins.description: see what your agent actually said behind your back. — a transparent proxy + web UI that logs the exact bytes your agent sends the model.

plugins.name: strawman
plugins.description: argue with yourself before the internet does. — red-team a prompt across jailbreak, injection, derailment, extraction, and ambiguity.

plugins.name: interrobang
plugins.description: make it ask before it acts. — flip the helpful-assistant reflex: ask one sharp clarifying question instead of guessing.

plugins.name: steno
plugins.description: two letters, and the prompt writes itself. — short aliases that expand into full prompts for common dev tasks.

plugins.name: salvage
plugins.description: rip the JSON out of the chatter. — extract and repair valid JSON buried in chatty LLM output (fences, trailing commas, Python literals).

plugins.name: frisk
plugins.description: pat it down before it ships. — scan text headed to the model for secrets and PII (API keys, tokens, private keys, emails) and redact or flag them.

plugins.name: tell
plugins.description: every AI has a tell. — flag the giveaways in AI-written prose (delve, tapestry, "it's not just X, it's Y", em-dash overuse).

plugins.name: tollbooth
plugins.description: know the bill before the bill. — estimate token count and dollar cost of a prompt across models before you send it.

plugins.name: bluff
plugins.description: call its bluff. — extract the URLs and citations from an answer and check they actually resolve, catching hallucinated links.

plugins.name: mole
plugins.description: find the plant. — sniff out prompt-injection and planted instructions hiding in untrusted input before it reaches the model.

plugins.name: launder
plugins.description: wash out the prints. — strip the mechanical fingerprints from text: zero-width chars, smart quotes, exotic spaces, em-dash tics.

plugins.name: alibi
plugins.description: does the story check out? — flag answer claims that aren't supported by the provided sources (a lexical grounding check for RAG).

plugins.name: fold
plugins.description: know when to fold. — catch overconfident phrasing and absolutes so the model hedges or abstains instead of bluffing.

plugins.name: grill
plugins.description: put it in the hot seat. — adversarially interrogate an answer with probing follow-ups before you trust it.

plugins.name: lineup
plugins.description: same prompt, the whole lineup. — run one prompt across several models and lay the answers side by side.

plugins.name: mugshot
plugins.description: we know your prints. — guess which model wrote a passage from its stylistic fingerprints (a heuristic, not proof).

plugins.name: squeeze
plugins.description: put the squeeze on it. — detect AI-generated text by how it compresses: model prose squeezes flatter against a known-AI corpus than a human one (after thinkst's zippy). A heuristic, not proof.

plugins.name: combo
plugins.description: pull the whole routine. — chain tricks into one pipeline so the output of one flows into the next: `combo "frisk | launder | deadpan"`.

plugins.name: protect-secrets
plugins.description: Secrets firewall for tool calls: denies (or asks, per level) any Read/Edit/Write/Bash/Grep that would read, search, modify, or exfiltrate .env files, SSH keys, cloud credentials, or keystores, with tiered safety levels tunable via HOOK_SAFETY_LEVEL.

plugins.name: git-safety
plugins.description: Branch-aware git guardrails plus destructive gh CLI protection: denies pushes to main/master, protected-branch deletion, direct commit/merge/rebase/reset/push on a protected branch, and gh pr merge/close, issue close, release and repo delete.

plugins.name: protect-tests
plugins.description: Stops "fake green" test-gaming: blocks the agent from deleting, renaming-away, or skip/xfail-disabling tests so it fixes the code instead, across pytest, jest, Go, JUnit, RSpec, and more.

plugins.name: case-insensitive-guard
plugins.description: Stops `rm -rf content` destroying `Content` on case-insensitive filesystems (APFS/exFAT/NTFS): resolves the real target of destructive commands through cd chains, quotes, and subshells, and denies provable case collisions.

plugins.name: config-guard
plugins.description: Who guards the guards: blocks the agent from tampering with its own guardrail config (settings.json, hook scripts, hooks.json, .mcp.json, plugin manifests, claude CLI config writes); reads always pass.

plugins.name: subagent-spawn-cap
plugins.description: Per-session subagent spawn budget: a PreToolUse guard on the Agent tool that counts every spawn (nested fan-outs included) in an append-only ledger, asks at SPAWN_CAP_ASK (default 20) and every SPAWN_CAP_ASK_STEP after it (default 10), and denies at SPAWN_CAP_DENY (default 60). The total cap Claude

plugins.name: config-watch
plugins.description: Tripwire for out-of-band config changes: warns on every mid-session settings/skills change (or blocks it with CONFIG_WATCH_BLOCK=true) to catch installer scripts and npm payloads rewriting settings behind Claude Code's back.

plugins.name: auto-stage
plugins.description: Automatic git staging: runs `git add` on every file Claude edits or writes, so `git status` always shows exactly what Claude touched and pre-commit review needs no manual staging.

plugins.name: format-code
plugins.description: Auto-formats files the moment Claude writes them: ruff for Python, prettier for JS/TS/JSON/MD/YAML/HTML, with shell-injection-safe argv execution and silent skips for everything else.

plugins.name: session-logger
plugins.description: Durable markdown log of every session (cwd, git repo, files touched, secret-redacted bash commands), appended async so logging never blocks Claude.

plugins.name: instructions-audit
plugins.description: Prompt-injection tripwire for CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules files: flags invisible-Unicode smuggling, secret read/exfil directives, curl|sh, decode-and-execute, and hook/settings tampering as instructions load, then locks the session (every prompt and tool call denied) until a human clears it.

plugins.name: notify-permission

plugins.name: guard-pack

description: Structured thinking skills for AI agents: brainstorming, decision support, systems thinking, and strategy. Built for Claude Code & Cursor.

plugins.name: ai-agent-skills

plugins.name: six-thinking-hats
plugins.description: Use for Six Thinking Hats or de Bono's parallel thinking, or when a decision or idea needs facts, gut feel, risks, benefits and new options kept apart: "look at this from all sides", "full perspective check". Skip for plain factual questions or single-angle hot takes.

plugins.name: critical-thinking
plugins.description: Use for critical thinking, or when the user wants a claim, plan or decision checked for weak spots: "is this right?", "what am I missing?", "poke holes", "sanity check", "devil's advocate", "red team this". Skip for execution-only tasks and wording edits.

plugins.name: systems-thinking
plugins.description: Use for systems thinking, or when a change may ripple beyond its target: "what are the side effects?", "why does this keep coming back?", "how do these teams or services affect each other?". Maps loops, delays and leverage points. Skip for single-step fixes.

plugins.name: creative-thinking
plugins.description: Use for creative thinking, or when the user wants many fresh options before choosing: "give me ideas", "brainstorm names", "other ways to do this", "think outside the box". Diverges first, then picks. Skip when one answer is wanted or the task is pure execution.

plugins.name: strategic-thinking
plugins.description: Use for strategic thinking, or when the user must choose a direction under constraints: "where should we focus?", "how do we win?", "roadmap for next year", "what should we not do?". Ends in explicit bets and risks. Skip for step-by-step implementation.

plugins.name: analytical-thinking
plugins.description: Use for analytical thinking, or when a question needs breaking down and evidence: "why did metric X drop?", "what drives this?", "break this down", "what data do we need?". Builds a tree, hypotheses and evidence, ends with an answer and key uncertainty. Skip for quick verdicts.

plugins.name: lateral-thinking
plugins.description: Use for lateral thinking, or when ideas feel stuck or incremental: "we've tried everything", "need a surprising angle", "break the pattern", "give me a wild idea that could work". Uses provocations and reframes. Skip for rule lookups or strict logical proofs.

plugins.name: design-thinking
plugins.description: Use for design thinking, or when a product or service problem needs user understanding before solutions: "what do users really need?", "how might we...", "plan a discovery sprint", "validate this concept". Skip when the spec is frozen or the task is code maintenance.

plugins.name: first-principles-thinking
plugins.description: Use for first principles thinking, or when the user questions an inherited default: "why do we do it this way?", "is this cost really necessary?", "should we copy what competitors do?". Strips analogies and rebuilds from fundamentals. Skip for convention-following checklists.

plugins.name: ethical-thinking
plugins.description: Use for ethical thinking, or when a plan could harm or unfairly burden people: "should we do this?", "is this fair?", "privacy or bias risk", "who gets hurt?". Maps stakeholders, harms, power and consent. Skip for legal advice, neutral fact lookups and implementation-only work.

plugins.name: five-whys
plugins.description: Use for the 5 Whys, or when the user wants the root cause of a failure: "why did this happen?", "this keeps breaking", "write the postmortem", "find the real cause". Asks why repeatedly with evidence at each step, then sets countermeasures. Skip for one-off typos or when the cause is already proven.

plugins.name: swot-analysis
plugins.description: Use for SWOT analysis, or when the user wants to assess where a team, product or company stands: "strengths and weaknesses", "should we enter this market?", "review our position", "competitor comparison". Turns findings into actions. Skip for detailed planning or pure market sizing.

plugins.name: pre-mortem
plugins.description: Use for a pre-mortem, or before committing to a plan, launch or migration: "what could go wrong?", "stress test this plan", "how might this fail?", "risks before we ship". Assumes failure, lists causes, ranks them and sets mitigations. Skip for explaining a failure that already happened.

plugins.name: tradeoff-analysis
plugins.description: Use for tradeoff analysis, or when the user must pick between concrete options: "A or B?", "which library should we use?", "build vs buy", "compare these approaches". Scores options on weighted criteria, tests sensitivity and reversibility. Skip for open ideation or single-option reviews.

plugins.name: prioritization
plugins.description: Use for prioritization, or when there are more tasks than capacity: "what should we do first?", "rank this backlog", "cut scope for the MVP", "RICE score these". Picks a method (RICE, ICE, MoSCoW, impact-effort), scores items and sets a cut line. Skip for choosing between two designs.

plugins.name: fermi-estimation
plugins.description: Use for Fermi estimation, or when a rough number is needed fast: "roughly how many...", "ballpark the cost", "estimate capacity or market size", "is this even feasible?". Decomposes, uses ranges and sanity-checks. Skip when exact data is available or a precise calculation is wanted.

plugins.name: thinking-method-selector
plugins.description: Use when the user describes a problem, decision or stuck situation but names no method: "how should I approach this?", "help me think this through", "we can't decide", "where do I start?". Picks the best-fit thinking method and runs it. Skip for plain execution tasks or when a method is named.

plugins.description: Design fluency for frontend development. 23 commands (/impeccable polish, /impeccable audit, /impeccable critique, etc.) with curated anti-pattern detection to stop AI-generated UI from looking generic.

description: 网文/小说写作 skill 包，覆盖长篇与短篇网络小说的扫榜、拆文、写作、去AI味、封面图全流程

plugins.name: story
plugins.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。自动路由扫榜、拆文与写作工具，并可通过 /story dashboard 启动本地写作工作台。

plugins.name: story-long-scan
plugins.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。

plugins.name: story-explore
plugins.description: 作品内只读问答。查询进度、角色、伏笔、时间线和设定，返回可追溯产物引用。

plugins.name: story-research
plugins.description: 小说创作资料研究。查证公开事实，区分证据与写作推断，交付来源和不确定性。

plugins.name: story-data-analyze
plugins.description: 平台后台数据归因分析。用「分发→回访→章内」三层框架定位读者流失的真实位置，按指标官方定义计算、防止误读。

plugins.name: story-long-analyze
plugins.description: 长篇网文拆文。深度拆解爆款长篇小说的黄金三章、人设架构、爽点设计、节奏控制。

plugins.name: story-long-write
plugins.description: 长篇网文写作。从大纲到正文，辅助长篇网络小说的创作，包括世界观、人物、情节线管理。

plugins.name: story-short-scan
plugins.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言故事、番茄短篇等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。

plugins.name: story-short-analyze
plugins.description: 短篇网文拆文。拆解爆款短篇小说的叙事结构、情绪曲线、反转技巧、钩子设计。

plugins.name: story-short-write
plugins.description: 短篇网文写作。辅助短篇小说创作，从构思到成稿，聚焦情绪拉扯与节奏把控。

plugins.name: story-deslop
plugins.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然。覆盖禁用词替换、句式去套路、心理外化、节奏打碎。

plugins.name: browser-cdp
plugins.description: 浏览器操控。通过 CDP 协议控制 Chrome，复用已有登录态，执行浏览器自动化操作。

plugins.name: story-setup
plugins.description: 网文写作环境部署。一键部署 hooks、rules、agents、CLAUDE.md 到写作项目，提供会话恢复、一致性检查、提交验证等自动化基础设施。

plugins.name: story-review
plugins.description: 多视角对抗式审查。full/lean 模式在已部署 reviewer agents 时并行 spawn；agents 缺失、异常、过旧或启动失败时自动降级 solo，参考文件不可读时使用内置 rubric fallback。内置番茄/起点/知乎三平台评分标准。

plugins.name: story-import
plugins.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容后续写作流程。

plugins.name: story-cover
plugins.description: 网文封面生成。分析书名题材，生成专业封面图，支持 10 大题材视觉风格。

plugins.name: story-release-package
plugins.description: 将通过发布审查的作品整理为书名、简介、标签、章节清单和可追溯发布材料。

plugins.name: story-publish
plugins.description: 通过项目关联的本地适配器预览、预检并发布已批准章节，支持番茄草稿、修改、立即发布和排期。

plugins.description: マルチテナント SaaS に固有の PR レビュー観点パック。テナント境界 / 課金・メータリング / 権限・監査ログ / データ保持・削除とマスキング / 個社要件と汎用性 の5軸を、検出方法つきのチェックリストとして提供する。

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: 事業形態に依存しないアーキテクチャレビュー観点パック。外部連携とトランザクション整合(outbox) / API・スキーマの後方互換 / 観測性と障害時の運用 の3軸。SaaS でなくても適用できる。

plugins.name: review-judge
plugins.description: レビューの拘束力ある最終判定だけを下す司法エージェント。観点別の所見と決定性チェックを束ね、PASS / REJECT / RETRY / ESCALATE を返す。Edit / Write を持たないため直すことができない。dev-conductor と loop-engine の双方が依存する共有基盤。

plugins.name: spec-intake
plugins.description: 立法の支援。GitHub issue での議論を、実装根拠になる spec-kit の仕様(specs/<機能>/)まで持ち上げる。grill-issue が曖昧な issue を質問攻めで詰め、spec-draft が spec-kit のコマンドで仕様を起草して仕様の PR にする。承認は必ず人間。自律ループを回さなくても単体で使える。

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: 開発の指揮。main に常駐する親が spec-kit で仕様を起草して仕様の PR を作り、承認された仕様を worktree の子に送り出す。子は行政に実装させ、書記に証拠を出させ、司法に持ち込み、PR 作成後に retro(学ぶループ)を非ブロッキングで招集し、マージ後は親が自動で下書きして人間の確認の後に投稿する。マージ済みの子の worktree は、親が安全条件を確かめて片付ける。自分ではコードを書かず判定も出さない。行政が司法を呼べない構造にすることで、実装した主体が合否を決められないようにする。

plugins.name: dev-crew
plugins.description: 行政(実務)の一式。契約に沿って実装し決定性証拠を揃える implement、出荷/運用の create-issue、書記の職能エージェント、PR 単位の振り返りを PR コメントと retro issue に残す学ぶループ(retro)。判定は出さず、証拠を揃えて指揮に返す。

plugins.name: loop-engine
plugins.description: 人間が承認した spec-kit の仕様を起点に拾い上げ→実装→司法検証→PR を回す自律ループ(HOTL)。loop-ready の issue を PR まで進め、必ず PR で停止する。dev-crew と review-judge が前提。

plugins.name: spec-page
plugins.description: 説明書・仕様書・設計文書を HTML 1枚にまとめる。一覧ではなく構造と決定の理由を伝える形式に落とし、配信環境で初めて出る欠陥を公開前チェックで潰す。Artifact と GitHub Pages の両方に対応。

plugins.name: quiz-after
plugins.description: After Claude finishes a task that changed something, shows 2-3 questions about what was built above the prompt. One cached fork on those turns only; /quiz turns it off.

plugins.name: next-steps-supervisor
plugins.description: After a turn that did real work, a cached side check asks whether the goal was met, where corners were cut and what needs your approval, with next steps as buttons. /supervisor turns it off.

plugins.name: assumption-ledger
plugins.description: Gives Claude a register_assumption tool and shows the turn's assumptions, decisions and considered-but-not-done items above the prompt. No model calls of its own.

plugins.name: mode-registry
plugins.description: One /mode switch any mod can add a mode to; the active mode shows in the prompt footer. No model calls.

plugins.name: effort-modes
plugins.description: Three modes on the /mode switch: ui (low effort), api (medium), review (max). Needs mode-registry. Each switch rebuilds the prompt cache once.

plugins.name: artifact-dashboard
plugins.description: A one-line summary of a shared Kanban artifact above the prompt, so several Claude sessions work from the same board. No model tokens.

description: Make the Claude Pro plan last longer: Claude Code mods for an exact usage HUD, shorter shell output and no repeat file reads. The mods spend zero tokens.

plugins.name: pro-hud
plugins.description: Desktop heads-up display: live session, week and context meters, per-turn token receipt, usage in the spinner, compact tool rows.

plugins.name: output-diet
plugins.description: Trims long shell output, Grep results and subagent reports before Claude reads them (head, tail and error lines kept); the untrimmed text is saved to a file Claude can open.

plugins.name: turn-budget
plugins.description: When one turn crosses +5 session points, writes a handoff with your latest prompt in full and copies it for a new session; the old session is never cleared. /handoff any time.

plugins.name: tool-diet
plugins.description: Loads tools you have not used lately on demand through ToolSearch instead of with every request; core tools and recently used ones stay loaded.

plugins.name: skill-diet
plugins.description: Lists skills you have not used lately in this project by name only, without their descriptions; the Skill tool and /name still load any of them.

plugins.name: agent-diet
plugins.description: Runs search-only subagents (Explore by default) on Haiku instead of your main model; a model Claude asks for still wins, and /agent-diet picks the types and the model.

plugins.name: context-xray
plugins.description: /xray opens a pane with the exact breakdown of what fills the context window and which tools load on every request.

plugins.name: reread-guard
plugins.description: Skips Claude's identical re-read of a file that has not changed, with Read or a plain cat, sed -n, head, tail or Get-Content; a deliberate retry still goes through.

plugins.name: write-guard
plugins.description: Steers Claude to Edit instead of rewriting an existing file in full: the first rewrite in a conversation gets a one-line note, a later one is held back once; a deliberate retry still goes through.

plugins.name: loop-guard
plugins.description: Holds back a shell command once when the exact same command already failed twice in a row, and tells Claude to change approach; retrying it still goes through.

plugins.name: cmd-diet
plugins.description: Adds quiet flags to noisy shell commands before they run (git status, pytest, cargo, npm install, mvn, curl, wget, docker pull), so Claude reads short output from the start; errors, failures and warnings stay in full.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Status line countdown until the prompt cache expires; once it has, the exact tokens your next message re-sends uncached.

plugins.name: read-cap
plugins.description: Stops a whole-file read of a file over 1,000 lines once, with Read, cat or Get-Content, and gives Claude an outline tool so it reads only the range it needs.

plugins.name: session-receipt
plugins.description: /receipt opens a pane with the exact tokens every turn of the session spent and the costliest turns.

plugins.name: budget-guard
plugins.description: Holds a prompt back once your 5-hour or weekly usage is at or over your limit (90% by default); sending it again goes through.

plugins.name: kit-updates
plugins.description: Installs updates to your claude-pro-kit mods by itself at session start, and announces new mods (or installs them too, with /kit-update auto-new on); /kit-update installs updates and new mods now.

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another chat on this machine changed in the last 30 minutes.

plugins.name: answer-pane
plugins.description: Explain, plan and ELI5 pages drawn natively in a side pane; plan decisions as buttons, Respond fills the prompt box.

plugins.name: peek
plugins.description: Typing "status" while background shells or subagents run opens a pane with each task's exact elapsed time and last output lines instead of sending the prompt to Claude; /peek opens it too.

plugins.name: compact-keeper
plugins.description: After a compaction, adds a note of exact facts from before it (your latest prompt in full, up to 4 earlier ones, the todo list, the last failed shell command, files edited), at most 4,000 characters, with no model call.

plugins.name: gh-account
plugins.description: Runs each git push, pull, fetch, clone and gh command with the token of the logged-in GitHub account that can see the repository's owner, without switching the active account.

plugins.name: prompt-polish
plugins.description: An Improve button above the prompt (and /polish) rewrites your draft with Opus at low effort (or Haiku or Sonnet) using the prompt-master rules and puts it back in the box, never sent; each press is one model call, with its exact tokens shown.

plugins.name: right-tool
plugins.description: Stop Claude using cat, grep, find, and sed in Bash when the Read, Grep, and Glob tools fit. Each redirected call saves a permission prompt and keeps raw shell output out of context.

plugins.name: show-paths
plugins.description: Put the file path on every Read, Edit, Write, Glob, and Grep row in the transcript, so you never expand a row just to learn which file it touched.

plugins.name: skill-diet
plugins.description: Slim a skill that loads too much: a short SKILL.md that routes to reference files by topic, duplicates removed, every rule kept, and the token cost before and after.

plugins.name: snake
plugins.description: Snake in a pane. Steer with w, a, s and d, eat the food, don't hit the walls or yourself. Pause with p, pick the speed, high score kept. Zero tokens.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: Your day, written for you. Every turn is logged; /standup turns today's work across every session on the machine into a three-bullet update, or a Markdown file.

plugins.name: style-cop
plugins.description: Enforce the style rules Claude keeps ignoring: banned words and phrases, a comment-density cap on added code, and files that must not gain comments. Rules live in .claude/style-cop.md and are both shown to Claude and enforced on edits.

plugins.name: sudoku
plugins.description: Sudoku in a pane. Three levels with one solution each, move with w a s d, type a digit, undo, a hint when stuck, and a clock that pauses when the pane closes. Best time per level kept. Zero tokens.

plugins.name: trigger-test
plugins.description: Find out whether a skill fires when it should and stays quiet when it shouldn't: eval cases in a user's words, run with claude plugin eval, and description edits until both pass.

plugins.name: tripwire
plugins.description: Stop secrets leaving the machine. Holds an edit or command that writes an API key, a private key, or a credential literal, a command that reads a secret file and talks to the network, and a git commit whose staged changes contain a secret. Refuses by default.

plugins.name: trust-but-verify
plugins.description: Check what Claude claims against what it ran. When an answer says the tests pass, the build is clean, or something was committed, a line under it says whether a matching command actually ran this turn and succeeded.

plugins.name: typing
plugins.description: Typing race in a pane. A line of code appears, you type it; every character colors right or wrong as you go, and Enter scores words per minute and accuracy. Last ten runs and your best kept. Zero tokens.

plugins.name: undo-agent
plugins.description: Undo the file edits a subagent made. /rewind restores your own turns, but not a subagent's edits; this snapshots them and puts the files back with one command.

plugins.name: vet-plugin
plugins.description: Audit a Claude Code plugin, mod, or skill before you install it: what it would do on your machine, what its README doesn't say, and whether to install.

plugins.name: watchtower
plugins.description: One line above the prompt showing what your guard mods are doing: the fence, pins, the breaker threshold, the test command and its last result, and every call refused this session.

description: KOZMOS — live, visual mods for Claude Code (CLI + desktop): bands above the prompt, sidebars, status ticker, companions, guards and sound.

description: 19 Claude Code plugins in one panel. See every move Claude makes: agents, files, plans, tests and risky commands, live.

plugins.description: Orchestrated delivery: the session model plans and reviews, five tiered worker agents implement. Pairs with savvy-progress.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: A file tree of what Claude touches: what it is doing now, the files touched this turn and their git status.

plugins.name: plan-steps
plugins.description: The plan's steps as Claude works through them, from the task list, an approved plan or a plan file. The plan comes back after /clear and compaction.

plugins.name: transceiver
plugins.description: Beta. Your team, inside Claude. Chat with teammates and let your agents ask theirs about the repo, at zero tokens.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Risky commands wait for your OK. rm -rf, git reset --hard, force pushes and migrations are held with exactly what they would change; so is an edit to a file another chat just changed.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops keys and tokens before they land: scans writes, edits, git add and commit, and blocks committing .env. Pasted keys reach the model as placeholders; /rec masks the screen.

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: A silent git snapshot before each turn's first write. /checkpoints lists the turns and undoes one.

plugins.name: test-badge
plugins.description: After a turn that edited source, runs tests and lint in the background and shows the result as a badge. Watches your PR's GitHub CI too.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Replays the last turn's edits step by step, each tied to its plan step, with a coloured diff; earlier turns and past sessions too.

plugins.name: session-budget
plugins.description: A spend budget per session, as a share of the 5-hour limit or in dollars: a notice at 80%, a stop at 100%, and a question before new subagents when the 5-hour window runs low.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm through breaks and shows what a cold send would cost, after a break or a model change. Warming uses tokens.

plugins.name: hud-pro
plugins.description: One quiet line above the prompt: the 5-hour limit and its reset, 7-day use, context and session cost. The Usage pane shows what fills the context and 7 or 30 days of usage history.

plugins.name: done-ping
plugins.description: A notification when a long turn finishes or Claude is waiting on you, with optional sound packs.

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Spots corrections in your prompts worth keeping and saves them to the CLAUDE.md you choose. /mine turns friction that repeats across past chats into ideas.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Themes for the transcript: tool rows, reply gutters and spinner words. /skin switches them live.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: A browser inside the terminal: preview sites and HTML files and let the agent drive it. Terminal only.

plugins.name: effort-router
plugins.description: Shows each turn's effort and model. In auto mode, light prompts go at low effort.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Before the context fills, writes a handoff note and hands it once to your next fresh chat in this repo.

plugins.name: compact-carry
plugins.description: Carries recent files, the last request, open todos and the branch across a compaction as a short note

plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: context fill, last turn's cost, session and subagent cost and rate limits; /gauge toggles it

plugins.name: prompt-shaper
plugins.description: Attaches git state to a prompt when it changed, and adds a stable project-toolchain note to the system prompt

plugins.name: long-turn-notify
plugins.description: macOS notification when a long turn finishes, or when Claude needs your input, in terminal sessions

plugins.name: merge-gate
plugins.description: Holds gh pr merge until CI passes on the PR head; /gate runs the project CI steps locally without a Claude turn

plugins.name: secret-scrubber
plugins.description: Masks API keys and tokens in tool output before Claude or the transcript sees them, and refuses writing them into source files

plugins.name: test-on-edit
plugins.description: When Claude's answer ends, runs the tests of the files it edited; failures go to Claude with your next prompt; refuses deleting or disabling tests (skip, xfail, only), flags dropped cases

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Suggests 2-3 likely next prompts after each turn, press 1/2/3 to draft one; /next off

plugins.name: mod-stats
plugins.description: /mod-stats [days] [here]: what each mod did, cost and saved, active/stale/dormant, hook time and faults; watches the other mods' hooks for faults

plugins.name: rule-score
plugins.description: /rules: how often Claude follows the checkable rules in your CLAUDE.md files, flagging chronically ignored ones as hook candidates

plugins.name: auto-test
plugins.description: Runs the project's tests once at the end of a turn in which Claude edited files, and shows a green or red result. Off until you type /auto-test on.

plugins.name: big-file-guard
plugins.description: Saves tokens: when the model reads a large data or log file whole, it gets the first lines and a note, unless it asks for a range itself.

plugins.name: branch-janitor
plugins.description: Watches your git branches by itself (nothing to run) and notices when a branch's work is done (merged, squash-merged, pull request merged), even if you merged in a plain terminal. Checks it is safe to delete and offers to delete it. Never deletes without a click; the remote copy is a second, separat

plugins.name: cache-guard
plugins.description: Stops you once before a message that would re-write a cold prompt cache, shows the price, and can keep the cache warm with /keepwarm.

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: One-click safety snapshots of your working tree (untracked files too) that never touch your branch, index or stash. /checkpoint, list, diff, restore, drop. Restore shows what would be lost and asks first.

plugins.name: command-guard
plugins.description: Holds risky Bash commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, DROP TABLE ...), shows exactly what they would destroy, and asks first. A safety net, not a permission system.

plugins.name: concise
plugins.description: While switched on, every prompt carries rules that shape Claude's replies so you can act on them: the next action first, numbered steps, state restated each turn, no tangents, specific time estimates. Off until you type /concise on.

plugins.name: contrast-check
plugins.description: Checks the contrast of a text colour on a background (WCAG 2.x AA and AAA) and suggests the nearest shade that passes. Pure arithmetic; reads no files.

plugins.name: data-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a git commit or git add takes in large files, data files, personal-looking table columns or Jupyter notebooks with outputs. Only names are ever shown, never file contents.

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: /decision <text> [-- rationale] adds a dated row to the project's docs/DECISIONS.md (the agents-md-scaffold table); /decision-log shows the last 20. Writes only that file, only when asked.

plugins.name: diagram
plugins.description: Draws the last mermaid diagram from Claude's answer as box art in a pane: run /diagram to open it. Flowcharts, sequence diagrams and pie charts; offline, no model tokens.

plugins.name: edit-replay
plugins.description: /replay steps through every file edit Claude made in the last turn (or the session), one diff at a time.

plugins.name: error-inbox
plugins.description: Keeps the last 30 failed or refused tool calls of the session in a pane, each with a button that drafts a prompt asking Claude to explain it. Watches only; never blocks.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: The project's file tree in a pane beside the chat, lit up as Claude reads, edits and commits files. Read-only.

plugins.name: format-on-edit
plugins.description: After Claude edits a file, formats just that file with the project's formatter (Air for R, Ruff for Python, Prettier or Biome for JS when the project uses one) and tells Claude to read it again. Off until you type /format-on-edit on.

plugins.name: long-run-ping
plugins.description: Pings you when a long model turn or a long Bash command ends, so you can look away: /long-run-ping [on|off|status|test].

plugins.name: method-review
plugins.description: Notices when Claude edits method code (genetics, statistics, estimation, simulation) and holds the first git commit or push until a second model has reviewed it. Enforces the rule that the implementer is never its own reviewer.

plugins.name: moddeck
plugins.description: A side bar with a live Session box, a Side Question panel (/btw), every mod in grouped cards (a switch is the mod's name, green on and red off; click it to flip), the skills and saved prompts, and an update check.

plugins.name: model-picker
plugins.description: Checks every prompt locally (zero tokens). When the current model is likely too weak or overkill, it blocks the prompt and shows a dialog ("Don't use X for this task"), recommending the model with the best predicted fit per cost.

plugins.name: progress
plugins.description: Live band and pane for Claude's plan tasks and subagents: task and helper progress bars, a subagent tree, tokens, est. cost, time and tool counts.

plugins.name: prompt-library
plugins.description: Keeps your saved prompts, per project: /prompts add, use, rename, remove. The moddeck side bar shows them.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: Turns a rough prompt into a great one before it is sent: up to three multiple-choice questions, a rewrite, and the original beside the upgrade in a pane. Nothing runs until you press Run. /better <prompt>, /better on|off|history.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Turns your corrections ("no, use pnpm", "never do X") into rules you can save to CLAUDE.md with one click.

plugins.name: repro-log
plugins.description: Keeps a reproducibility recipe for data work: the analysis commands that succeeded and the files you changed. /repro writes it to .moddeck/repro/ with git commit, versions, lock files, seeds and a runnable command list. Secrets are never written.

plugins.name: review-cost
plugins.description: Before a git push triggers the automatic second-model review, shows its estimated token cost (green / amber / red) and lets you choose Review or Skip.

plugins.name: scope-watch
plugins.description: Set the folder you are working in; when Claude edits a file outside it, you get a toast and Claude gets a short note to check the edit was intended. Never blocks.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Keeps secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys) out of the model's context: hides them in tool output and asks before a typed prompt that contains one is sent.

plugins.name: skill-router
plugins.description: Adds one line to a prompt that clearly matches a skill (review, plan-first, writing, ahpcc, assess-plugin, agents-md-scaffold), so the skill is used when the task calls for it. Local keyword match, no model call, once per skill per session.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Skins for Claude Code: tool rows that open onto their input and answer, highlighted code, diff, table, math, Mermaid and shell cards, a usage band and fifteen colour themes. Pick one in the moddeck side bar or with /skin. By hellosverre (MIT), vendored without the update check and star ask.

plugins.name: ssh-connect
plugins.description: One-click SSH from the moddeck side bar: /ssh connect|shell|status|disconnect opens your terminal on a host from ~/.ssh/config, so you type any password or 2FA code yourself. macOS, Linux and Windows.

description: jr Claude Code mods: 43 free, open-source mods for Claude Code. Context bar, plan limits, prompt cache countdown, system monitor, billable time, safety guards, dictation fixes. One-line install each, no tokens.

plugins.name: jr-context
plugins.description: The context window in one quiet row above the prompt: a mini bar coloured by category, the fill and the window, turning into an alert when compaction is near. /jr-context hides or shows it, /jr-context details opens the full bar with its legend.

plugins.name: jr-limits
plugins.description: Plan limits in one quiet row above the prompt: the 5-hour and 7-day fill and when the fullest resets, an alert from 80 %, a toast at 80 % and 95 %. /jr-limits hides or shows it, /jr-limits details opens the gauges.

plugins.name: jr-cache-clock
plugins.description: A toast 30 seconds before the prompt cache goes cold, and on /jr-cache-clock a quiet countdown above the prompt: how long the cache stays warm after Claude's last reply, going green to red, and the last cache hit rate.

plugins.name: jr-next-cost
plugins.description: What the next prompt costs before you send it, on /jr-next-cost: the context it resends at the current model's price, read from a warm cache or written to a cold one, at API rates.

plugins.name: jr-quota
plugins.description: Balances of the other paid APIs you use (OpenRouter, Firecrawl, DeepSeek), checked every 10 minutes: /jr-quota details shows them all, /jr-quota hides or shows the band; a band and a toast appear only when one runs low.

plugins.name: jr-read-cap
plugins.description: Stops Claude from reading a long file whole: a Read of a file over 1,000 lines without a range is refused with a hint to grep first and read only the lines it needs. Saves context and tokens.

plugins.name: jr-time
plugins.description: Billable time per project: every minute of a session sorted into categories, a ratio per category, an hourly rate, and an amount. /jr-time to adjust, export to CSV or Markdown.

plugins.name: jr-week
plugins.description: /jr-week: your week with Claude Code, per day and per project: time Claude worked, prompts and cost, with gradient bars and a Markdown export.

plugins.name: jr-heatmap
plugins.description: /jr-heatmap: your last 26 weeks with Claude Code as a GitHub-style heatmap, with current and longest streak and your peak hours.

plugins.name: jr-wrapped
plugins.description: /jr-wrapped: your month with Claude Code, Wrapped-style: prompts, hours, streak, busiest hour, top tools and projects, a persona, and a share card saved as SVG and PNG.

plugins.name: jr-stripemrr
plugins.description: Your Stripe MRR and today's revenue above the prompt, refreshed every 15 minutes; /jr-stripemrr adds the last 30 days as a sparkline.

plugins.name: jr-visitors
plugins.description: Live visitors from PostHog above the prompt (last 5 minutes and today), refreshed every 2 minutes; /jr-visitors adds today's top pages.

plugins.name: jr-uptime
plugins.description: Pings your sites every 2 minutes; a red band above the prompt the moment one goes down, and /jr-uptime with latency sparklines and the last incident.

plugins.name: jr-outage
plugins.description: Is it them or is it me? The status of Claude, GitHub, npm and Vercel, checked every 10 minutes: /jr-outage shows them all, a band and a toast appear only when one is degraded.

plugins.name: jr-done-check
plugins.description: Flags replies that claim something was tested or verified when nothing was run in the turn to check it: a warning under the message and a toast.

plugins.name: jr-no-promise
plugins.description: When a reply ends by announcing work ("I'll…", "Let me…", "je vais…") and no tool ran in the turn, Claude is sent back once to actually do it.

plugins.name: jr-scope
plugins.description: Warns when a turn writes sensitive files nobody asked for (lockfiles, manifests, CI, .env, migrations, infra) or too many files at once.

plugins.name: jr-commit-coach
plugins.description: Nudges you toward small atomic commits: when uncommitted changes pass a threshold, a band and a toast suggest a split by folder.

plugins.name: jr-nudges
plugins.description: At the end of a turn, one toast when the code Claude wrote added debug statements (console.log, print, debugger) or TODO/FIXME/HACK lines.

plugins.name: jr-pkg-guard
plugins.description: Checks every package install against its registry first: names that do not exist (hallucinated or typosquatted) are refused, very new packages are held back or flagged, install scripts are flagged.

plugins.name: jr-mod-audit
plugins.description: /jr-mod-audit owner/repo: clones a mod, runs the official validator on each plugin in it, reads its source, and shows what it can reach with a green, amber or red verdict before you install it.

plugins.name: jr-deploy-guard
plugins.description: Production deploys and pushes to main always come to you for confirmation, even when your rules allow them. Optional: no deploys on Friday.

plugins.name: jr-explain
plugins.description: Every shell command Claude asks permission for comes with a plain-English explanation and a risk level: low, medium or high.

plugins.name: jr-redact
plugins.description: Replaces API keys, tokens, private keys and database passwords in tool results with placeholders before Claude reads them. Emails and IPs too, if you ask.

plugins.name: jr-record
plugins.description: Recording mode for demos and screen shares: /jr-record masks emails, money amounts, keys, phone numbers and IPs on screen. Claude still reads the real text.

plugins.name: jr-image-guard
plugins.description: Keeps oversized images out of the conversation: an image over 7800 px is read through a resized copy, and browser viewports over the limit are refused.

plugins.name: jr-no-ai-trailer
plugins.description: Stops commits and pull requests that carry an AI co-author line or a 'Generated with' footer, so your history stays yours.

plugins.name: jr-dictation
plugins.description: Fixes what dictation mishears ("cloud code" → Claude Code) before Claude reads your prompt, and shows each fix in your prompt row: red struck, green added.

plugins.name: jr-polish
plugins.description: /jr-polish <rough prompt>: a small fast model rewrites it into a clear, structured prompt in the same language and puts it in your prompt box to edit and send.

plugins.name: jr-draft
plugins.description: /jr-draft: a scratch pane to write your next prompt while Claude works, kept per project, sent to the prompt box when you are ready.

description: Skills and plugins from https://daily.dev/marketplace made by daily.dev community.

plugins.name: ai-engineer-reading-list
plugins.description: Every week, your agent pulls the most-upvoted daily.dev posts on LLM inference, RAG and AI agents, saves them to your bookmarks, and writes you a one-page brief. Curated lanes, ranked by the community, no filler.

plugins.name: bookmark-lab
plugins.description: Turn your daily.dev bookmarks into hands-on practice. Pick an article and get a focused coding exercise, clear success checks, and feedback on your solution.

plugins.name: bookmark-recap
plugins.description: Turns what you bookmarked on daily.dev this week into a short reading report you can paste into standup, Slack or a newsletter. Groups your saves by topic, pulls the one-line summaries and tells you what's worth reading first.

plugins.name: bookmarks-roulette
plugins.description: Your bookmarks pile up and rot. Spin the cylinder and one forgotten bookmark comes up: spare it and go read it, or pull the trigger and it's deleted from daily.dev for good. Try the demo first, no account needed.

plugins.name: bookmarks-to-notes
plugins.description: Exports your daily.dev bookmarks to Markdown notes for Obsidian, Logseq or any folder of files: one note per post with summary, tags, source and links. Later runs sync only what's new, so your second brain stays current without duplicates.

plugins.name: branch-reads
plugins.description: Your feed knows what you follow. Branch Reads knows what you're building right now. It reads your git branch, spots the libraries, APIs and patterns you're touching, and finds the 3-5 daily.dev posts worth reading for that exact change.

plugins.name: community-check
plugins.description: Before you adopt a tool or technique, find out what developers on daily.dev actually think. Reads the most-discussed posts and their comment threads on a topic and summarizes the consensus, the dissent and the production gotchas, with sources.

plugins.name: daily-dev-statusline
plugins.description: Rotating daily.dev headlines at the bottom of Claude Code while you wait. Curated major headlines plus the community's most-upvoted posts of the day, clickable in your terminal. No API token needed.

plugins.name: discord-dm-digest
plugins.description: Get your own daily.dev digest as a Discord DM: new posts from your For You feed, the popular feed or one of your custom feeds, at the time and days you choose. Each member uses their own account.

plugins.name: feed-builder
plugins.description: Describe a feed in plain English, like "Rust backend and observability, 50+ upvotes, no videos", and get a daily.dev custom feed with the right tags, sources and thresholds. Your agent resolves the tags, creates the feed, applies the filters and shows you what it returns.

plugins.name: feed-tuner
plugins.description: Compares what you bookmark on daily.dev with the tags and sources you follow, then proposes follow, unfollow and unblock changes and applies only the ones you approve. Your saves tell the truth about what you want to read.

plugins.name: hot-take-drafter
plugins.description: Finds the most-argued post on daily.dev this week, lays out both sides from the comment thread, and drafts three takes you could post: the contrarian, the synthesis and the sharp question. Spicy but fair, and you press send, not the agent.

plugins.name: inbox-zero
plugins.description: Summarizes your daily.dev notifications in one short briefing, split into what needs you (replies, mentions, squad reviews), what's social, and what's just new content, with links on everything actionable. Marks them all read only when you say so.

plugins.name: interest-agent
plugins.description: Name a topic you want to keep up with and your agent turns it into a brief, hunts daily.dev and the web for what you would not want to miss, remembers your taste between conversations, and can keep a daily.dev custom feed tuned to it.

plugins.name: on-call-lookup
plugins.description: Paste an error or a log line from an incident. Your agent searches daily.dev for posts about the same failure, reads the comments for corrections, and gives you the likely causes, the checks to run first and the fixes, each with its source. It sends only generic terms, never hostnames or secrets.

plugins.name: profile-autofill
plugins.description: Paste your CV, LinkedIn export or a short career summary and your agent fills in your daily.dev work history, education, projects, certifications and tech stack. You approve the plan first; nothing is invented and nothing existing is overwritten.

plugins.name: read-next
plugins.description: Turns your daily.dev bookmarks into a realistic reading queue based on the time you have, the topics you care about, and what is actually worth reading next.

plugins.name: release-radar
plugins.description: A weekly changelog for your stack, from daily.dev. Finds release notes, breaking changes, deprecations and migration posts for the tags you follow, writes a digest that leads with what breaks, and can save the posts to a bookmark list.

plugins.name: stack-sync
plugins.description: Point your agent at a repository. It reads the dependency manifests, updates your daily.dev tech stack and follows the matching tags, so your feed matches what you actually build. You see the plan before anything changes.

plugins.name: tool-showdown
plugins.description: Name two tools, like "OpenTofu vs Terraform". Your agent searches daily.dev for comparisons, migration stories and recent news on both, marks which posts come from a vendor, reads the comments, and gives a verdict with its evidence. If daily.dev has too little, it says so.

plugins.name: trend-radar
plugins.description: Which tags and tools are rising in your corner of the ecosystem this week? Trend Radar compares daily.dev's popular feed against last week's snapshot and surfaces what broke in, what cooled off, and the posts that drove the change.

plugins.name: upgrade-scout
plugins.description: Bumping a dependency, or reviewing a PR that does? Upgrade Scout pulls migration guides, gotchas and community reactions from daily.dev for that library and version, and gives you a verdict before you run the upgrade.

plugins.name: python-django-stress-test

plugins.name: typescript-nestjs-stress-test
plugins.description: NestJS 서버 부하 측정을 준비한다 — prom-client 지연 히스토그램 · in-flight 게이지 계측, nest start · ts-node · debug 로그 같은 무효 설정 탐지, Express/Fastify 어댑터 · 요청 스코프 · DB 풀 손잡이 확인, tinybench 마이크로벤치마크.

plugins.name: common-performance-review

description: Claude Code plugin marketplace: mods and teaching course

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.

plugins.name: delete-backup
plugins.description: Copies the files an rm is about to delete into a backup folder first, so /undo-delete can put the newest deletion back

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: claude-reflect as a Claude Code mod: a model check on each short prompt finds reusable corrections (any language); a band above the prompt saves them to CLAUDE.md on one press

plugins.name: mod-store
plugins.description: /mods: browse, search and install community Claude Code mods from a pane, with what each one can access shown before you install

plugins.name: mod-doctor
plugins.description: Mod doctor audits your installed mods with the plugin validator and flags failed checks, shared tool.call hooks and duplicate names

plugins.name: effort-picker
plugins.description: Picks the reasoning effort for each message you send, for that message only, from its words, and never switches the model

plugins.name: assumption-check
plugins.description: After a reply, lists the small guesses Claude made. Mark each Right or Wrong, and send the wrong ones back to Claude

plugins.name: secret-box
plugins.description: Claude can use a secret without seeing it: a masked box saves keys to .env and gives Claude a placeholder, every key a tool prints comes back as a placeholder, and committing .env is refused

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: Read-only side chat: /aside opens a pane beside the transcript where you ask about the session so far; answers come from a tool-less fork of the session's own transcript and nothing is written back into the main thread.

plugins.name: prompt-bouncer
plugins.description: Bounces vague prompts before Claude sees them, and suggests the project's own term

plugins.name: dictation-fixer
plugins.description: Tidies long messages that look dictated, then asks whether to send the cleaned version or the text as typed

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. Warming uses model requests and costs tokens. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: ctx-handoff
plugins.description: Turns what you teach Claude into project notes, catches its usual slips, keeps the cache warm while you're away, and picks long sessions back up

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Replay Theater: step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: recording-mode
plugins.description: /rec before you record: masks keys, personal details, and business figures on screen and keeps private files closed (/rec strict, /rec off, /rec config)

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Asks before Edit or Write changes a file that another chat edited in the last 30 minutes, with Proceed and Cancel

plugins.name: where-am-i
plugins.description: A live recap above the prompt: goal, doing now, waiting on you, next. /where for a longer one.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Your plan's 5-hour and 7-day usage as small bars above the prompt, with the reset countdown and the session's cost.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: /mission opens a live map of the main agent, its subagents and every tool call, plus a code map of the files they touch.

plugins.name: test-fail-magnet
plugins.description: Keeps the failing tests from your last test run in a Failing tests pane, with Fix to send them to Claude and Dismiss to clear them

plugins.name: prompt-queue
plugins.description: A prompt typed while Claude is working is held in a stack above the prompt instead of landing in the running turn, and sent once the turn ends. Reorder the stack, edit a row in place, send one first, remove one, flush the lot. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.

plugins.name: spend-guard
plugins.description: Asks Proceed or Cancel, with a short checklist, before a command or MCP tool that costs money or publishes runs

plugins.name: heads-up
plugins.description: After a long turn, one Haiku call flags up to two things you might miss, in a band above the prompt. Off until /heads-up on

plugins.name: human-in-the-loop
plugins.description: Claude assigns you the tasks only you can do. They wait in a My tasks pane, counted under the prompt, until you answer or reject them, so nothing Claude needs from you gets lost in the chat.

plugins.name: diagram-pane
plugins.description: A side pane that pins every diagram Claude draws, keeps a live map of the work, and lets you go into boxes and change them

plugins.name: decision-tree
plugins.description: When Claude ends a reply with a question, explains the choice in a side pane and lets you explore any option, or your own, in a real forked session

plugins.name: plain-english
plugins.description: While on, rewrites each long reply in plain language with a short Next steps list, in a side pane, and leaves Claude's reply unchanged

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Colorful, themeable rendering for Claude Code replies: tables, headings, code, numbers, paths and links.

plugins.description: A browser running directly inside claude code. Preview websites, view HTML documents, and let your agent control the built in browser.
